independence.basis: review built from source bytes + delivered artefact bytes + upstream payload; no producer explanation consumed

disposition_rationale: 17/19 independent checks pass; both failing checks are documentation/structural nits (F1, F5) that do not change any byte of the reviewed artefact; the one major finding (F2) is a platform-level gate gap, and the independent recheck shows the risk is not realised.

every locator start_line equals the recomputed line of start_char
span length end-start equals quote length (no silent truncation)
counts.by_class / by_resolution reproduced from the asset array

findings.title: Limitation clause ⑤.7 is stale: repo envelope schema root cause is not reproducible
findings.claim_audited: reported limitation: scripts/kf/wp-5760-01 report states 'schemas/kf_result.v1.schema.json 在仓内不存在'
findings.impact: Documentation only: the envelope validates against the repo schema with zero errors, so no artefact is wrong. The derived package-level schema remains justified by the separate, verified fact that repo v1 hardcodes package_id=wp-448-01 (C18).
findings.remediation: Restate the limitation with the branch point/commit it was true for, or point schema_ref at the repo schema once the const is generalised by the platform owner.

findings.title: 52 locator assertions are only self-attested at platform level
findings.impact: Risk not realised: an outside re-implementation reproduces all 52 spans and 52 start-line numbers exactly. But the capability claim ('locators are verifiable') is not protected by any platform gate, so a future package could regress silently.
findings.remediation: Platform: let task_type 01 register its locators as evidence locators so g5 counts them; reviewer-side: keep an external recheck (this package ships one).

findings.title: Figure caption carries numbers that no byte in this package can support
findings.claim_audited: figures[0] caption asserts 'R3 fire 01:23 / R1 fire 01:10 / 断档 147.55 min'
findings.impact: The PNG is genuinely absent (no png_base64 anywhere; declared_absent is honest), so the caption's numbers are WITHHELD at this layer and must be judged against the report text (where the same numbers are present). No drop of scope; a reader must not treat the caption as evidence.
findings.remediation: Downstream consumers should route figure-caption numbers to the report text; no change requested from the producer.

findings.title: locator interval convention (end_char exclusive) is undocumented
findings.claim_audited: A01 registers chars 0-6808 for a 6808-char document
findings.impact: No error: every quote equals md[start:end] (half-open), so end_char==6808 is correct; only the convention is implicit and a reader could miscount by one char.

findings.title: A01 quote is not its own char slice: locator rule not uniform across the 52 assets
findings.claim_audited: locator = char span + line + verbatim quote, quote = markdown[start_char:end_char]

evidence.manifest_note: The registered asset itself. quote pinned to the H1 title line; method=document covers the whole charset span 0..6808.

findings.impact: 51/52 assets satisfy quote == md[start:end] exactly; A01 (method=document) pins a 47-char H1 title inside a 6808-char span, so a uniform checker must special-case it and a reader cannot separate span extent from quote extent. Intent is documented in the manifest note, so no byte is misregistered.
findings.remediation: Split A01 into a document span without quote + a separate H1 anchor asset, or set end_char to the H1 line end and carry document length in its own field.

semantic_fidelity.judgement: faithful: every registered locator is the verbatim source slice, the class census is reproducible by an independent rule, and no extension-bearing path token in the source is left unregistered. Fidelity is NOT asserted for the truth of the report's own engineering numbers (out of scope for task_type 01).

not_run: Running the reviewed package's own build/verify pipeline (scripts/kf/build_asset_manifest_5760.py) — would re-write the producer's package directory, outside this work package's boundary.
Resolving referenced paths inside the producing repo TensorPlatform (ops/taskplane/stall_detector.py, artifacts/in20_r5/**): not present in TensorKnowledge; kept as upstream-declared unresolved.
Executing the report's repro_cmd (it writes artifacts/in20_r5/** in TensorPlatform).
Rendering/validating fig_stall_timeline.png pixels — no PNG bytes exist in the report payload.
Any judgement of the IN20-R5 mechanism's numerical accuracy (that is task_type 03/02 scope, not 01).
limitations: Independence is input-level: I received the report markdown, the delivered asset_manifest.json and the upstream KF-RESULT report (payload + its limitation clauses). I did not read producer chat, prompts or scratch reasoning; no producer sentence was reused as my review prompt.
I cannot prove which commit the producer had checked out at run time; F1 is therefore phrased as 'not reproducible on current HEAD' with the commit that introduced the schema file.
The source report body itself is out of scope for re-derivation of its physics/mechanism numbers; this review audits registration fidelity and locator truth, not the IN20-R5 claims' truth.
Grading is my own; the platform verification state of wp-5760-01 is not changed by this report and no upstream claim is marked verified here.
